name: 2023-2c-parcial2
title: MineField
description: A minefield board game: a player moves one step at a time on a configurable board with low- and high-power mines, light and heavy armours and bi-directional tunnels, wins on reaching the top row and loses when out of lives. The student must design and implement the whole model from scratch using TDD.

design.notes: Heterogeneous field elements (mines, armour racks, tunnels, nothing) and the armour the player wears (none, light, heavy, with per-use consumption) call for double dispatch between element and armour instead of ifs, plus recursive landing after flying, board-bound validation and a valid-creation protocol.
